pattern: # The PPB fascicles list mandates grouped under plain-text body headers (e.g.
# "Commission on Narcotic Drugs resolutions") and only hyperlink the principal-
# organ families (A/RES, E/RES, S/RES). The pipeline therefore captures the body
# header as `source`/`ppb_document_source` but leaves the organ unset. This table
# maps that header text to an organ short code so every cited mandate is
# attributed to its body (matching the manual 2026 curation conventions:
# validated to reproduce 60/62 of the 2026 human decisions).
# Matching is first-match by ascending `priority`, case-insensitive substring
# (source ILIKE '%pattern%'). Order specifics before generics; SC before Charter
# so "Security Council … Article 29 of the Charter …" resolves to SC.
# CANONICAL COPY. The SQL side mirrors this in migration 028
# (ppb2026.body_source_organ_map); keep the two in sync when editing.
Governing Council of the United Nations Environment Programme
Economic and Social Commission for Asia
Economic and Social Commission for Western Asia
